title: Damaal Dumeel
desc: A young, money-minded IT professional leads a happy life, until he gets fired from his job.

title: Yengalai Pol Yaarum Illai
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Yakhshee
desc: An unknown spirit protects a woman from possible threats. However, when the woman falls in love with a man, the spirit is not too happy about it.

title: Subhamastu
desc: Brothers Anna Rao and Chinna Rao dote on each other. However, when both their daughters, Kasturi and Saroja, wish to marry their driver Premchand, they turn into enemies.

title: Roberrt
desc: Raghava, the head cook in a catering unit, leads a peaceful life with his son Arjun. However, their bliss is short-lived as Raghava's past comes back to haunt him.

title: Kadhalar Kudiyiruppu
desc: A man aids his friend's son in becoming a police officer, but complications arise when his daughter falls in love with the new recruit and urges elopement.

title: Khiladi Doss
desc: Dasu unwittingly becomes embroiled in an illegal drug lord's nefarious operations. However, he soon catches wind of what's going on and decides to retaliate.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A compilation of catchy and entertaining popular songs composed by famed artists and musicians from varied Tamil movies.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Chekka Chivantha Vaanam
desc: Three brothers fight with one another for their father's criminal empire after his death. However, things take a turn when someone else takes advantage of their feud.

title: Naan Sigappu Manithan
desc: After his lover is brutally attacked and left in a coma, Indhiran, who suffers from narcolepsy, becomes a vigilante to take revenge.

title: Unnaiththane
desc: A Christian Zumba instructor and a Hindu upper-caste woman bond over dance and fall in love. But their relationship faces struggles as they face discrimination due to their caste.

title: Nimir
desc: Selvam, a photographer, lives in a town with a small studio of his own. One day, when he gets assaulted, he decides to not wear his slippers until he gets revenge on the culprits.

title: Chevaikalemai
desc: In a village, people are dying of strange circumstances which causes fear and chaos among villagers. A newly appointed police officer investigates and discovers absurd suspects.

title: Draupathi
desc: Accused of his wife's murder in an alleged honor killing, Rudra Prabhakaran is jailed. Subsequently, he descends into a dark path of vengeance after posting bail.
